user_need_match.quote: perf(tui): instant typing — Pane cache + non-blocking keystroke I/O + bounded drain loop (200 chars in 642ms)
user_need_match.evidence: The pane cache (session.rs:117,266-284) eliminates per-keystroke RPC resolution. The fire-and-forget tokio::spawn pattern (main.rs:1005-1022,1031-1038) makes keystrokes non-blocking. The drain loop (main.rs:608-1076) with 8ms budget drains all queued events before redrawing. The CACHED_MANAGER singleton (session.rs:125) reuses one socket. Together these achieve the 200-char/642ms result. One regression exists: tokio::spawn order is non-deterministic, violating keystroke sequencing — actively being fixed by worker 2-2.

hinge_findings.concern: 5 tokio::spawn fire-and-forget calls. Multi-threaded tokio schedules these independently. Tasks racing to pane.send_text_raw() arrive at the rmux transport mpsc in non-deterministic order. Fast typists can see scrambled output.
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: NOT SAFE — confirmed by grep showing 5 spawn sites with no ordering channel. This is the regression identified in obs:45165 and being fixed by worker OmegaOS-worker-2-2.

hinge_findings.concern: OnceCell singleton — correct for performance but no reconnect path on daemon restart
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: Verified via grep: get_or_try_init initializes once. is_pane_stale does NOT match io::Error. Daemon restart → all sends fail until omega restart.

hinge_findings.concern: 8ms budget check fires AFTER event processing. Async actions (KillSession) can exceed budget.
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: Acceptable tradeoff: kill is rare, and the cost is one missed 16ms redraw frame. Not a correctness issue.

hinge_findings.concern: Lock dropped between cache miss and RPC; two concurrent callers may both do RPCs
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: or_insert_with ensures last writer wins with equivalent pane. Both point to same daemon-side pane. Benign. Comment at session.rs:272 correctly documents this.

edge_cases.scenario: User holds a key down (key-repeat at 30-50ms). OS generates 20+ events/second. Each spawns a task. Under high concurrency the runtime may reorder tasks up to 10-20ms apart, causing visible character transpositions in the target REPL.
edge_cases.evidence_gathered: tokio::spawn with no synchronization, 5 sites confirmed via grep

edge_cases.scenario: rmux daemon crashes and auto-restarts (e.g., OOM kill). CACHED_MANAGER holds the old Arc<Rmux> pointing to the dead socket. All subsequent ForwardCharToSession calls produce 'Forward failed: ...' errors until the user quits and restarts omega.
edge_cases.evidence_gathered: OnceCell confirmed via grep; is_pane_stale only matches PaneNotFound | OwnedSessionLeaseLost
